contents.name: §4.5 entropy-integral inference
contents.support: The source assertion is tested by a formal positive-temperature response branch: the entropy integral converges while capacity is proportional to sqrt(T/T*), not O((T/T*)^m) for any integer m>=1.

contents.name: §4.5 residual entropy in a finite canonical model
contents.support: The local example supplies the finite-state Gibbs calculation under an explicitly assumed positive gap and degeneracy; it does not identify this entropy with the macroscopic postulate.
